title: A bug's proof (contract bug-proof v1, Phase 3)
description: Whether a reproduction test fails on the ticket's expected result before any fix (D75, D76). Each attempt is kept with its hint, test, runs and outcome; the latest attempt is the current outcome. Stored in .stangent/tickets/<KEY>/bug-proof.json; the test itself goes into the repo's test project with the fix.

result.description: runner-error: the test runner itself failed before any test ran (D90), a setup problem.

outcome.description: reproduced: fails on the named assertion (the code differs from what the reporter expected; the developer confirms it is the reported problem and a bug, D96); not-reproduced: the test passes, or the attempt hit its cap; not-reproduced-flaky: a Playwright test that passed on one of its 3 runs; not-provable: no unit or Playwright test can reach it here; failed: no valid test after the one retry.

outside.description: Not provable because of a part outside the code (D83): skipped when every part is, or the reproducer's answer accepted without the retry.

advice.description: What the developer can do about a setup failure (D91), chosen by code; stangent never installs anything itself.

setupBlocked.description: Failed because of the setup, not the reproducer (D89–D91): Claude Code refused something stangent's own rules allow, the test runner couldn't run (a missing runtime or tool), or the app didn't build or start. See `advice`; the next run tries again.

commit.description: The commit the test ran on (with -dirty when the working tree had changes beyond the test).

targetSpec.description: The test target as it was, so --verify runs the same commands.

actualQuote.description: The ticket's actual result, word for word (D95).

shows.description: Reproduced attempts only: the words of the failure message that show it, as the reproducer gave them; code checked they are in the message and not in the test's source (D95).

baseline.description: Other tests in the target already failing at this commit: --verify allows only these.

testHash.description: Reproduced attempts only: the test file as it was, so --verify can say if it was edited since (D105).

confirmedBy.description: The developer who confirmed the failure is the reported problem and a bug. Until then a reproduced outcome only shows the code differs from what the reporter expected (D96).

verification.description: On the fix branch (stangent ticket prove --verify): the test passes and nothing else started failing (D18).

result.description: What the test did here (D105; absent on records from before it). passed: it passes and nothing new fails; new-failures: it passes, other tests started failing; same-failure: it fails with the words its proof named (shows; a proof without them compares the message); different-failure: it fails, but those words are gone; not-compiled: it couldn't build; not-run: a timeout, no test found, a runner error or the test file not on the branch. A person reads anything but a pass, and a pass can still be for the wrong reason.

reason.description: The result in a sentence, for the developer.

othersChecked.description: A full run of the target judged the other tests. False for Playwright (it has none), a build that failed, a missing test file, or a run that gave no results (a timeout, no report or an unreadable one, none in it): passed then means only the test passes.

testChanged.description: The test file differs from when it was reproduced; null when the proof didn't record it, or the file isn't here.

newFailures.description: Tests failing here that weren't in the baseline; the reproduction test only when it passes alone and fails with the rest.
